mechanics.claim: Killing an enemy grants bonus gold with a chance-based amount, not a fight-relevant damage/survival effect.
mechanics.quote: Whenever '''Twisted Fate''' kills an enemy, he generates {{g|icononly=true}}{{pp|type=chance|1 to 6 for 6|key1=%|100*2/3/5 to 100*2/3/5;100/3|color=gold}}

mechanics.claim: Twisted Fate's critical strike chance increases the odds of gaining additional bonus gold on a kill.
mechanics.quote: He also has a chance equal to his {{as|critical strike chance}} to generate an additional {{g|{{pp|type=chance|1 to 6 for 6|key1=%|100/3;100*2/3/5 to 100*2/3/5|color=gold}}}}
